name: Anthropic Claude API (stub)
notes: STUB pack to prove the engine is provider-neutral. It contains only facts from Anthropic's model deprecations page (read 15 Oct 2026; API parameter deprecations re-read 22 Oct 2026), for the Claude API. Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud set their own retirement dates and are NOT covered.

No live API checks have been run against Anthropic. No aliases or eval adapter. Sampling-parameter rules: claude-sampling-deprecated (Claude 4.7+ models, earlier API versions) and the two anthropic-version 2026-10-21 rules, which are never applied automatically.

confirmed: claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 is deprecated and retires on the Claude API on 30 Nov 2026; recommended replacement claude-sonnet-5-5.
Anthropic gives at least 60 days' notice before retiring publicly released models.
Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud set their own retirement schedules; these dates apply to Anthropic-operated platforms only.
temperature, top_p and top_k are deprecated on Claude 4.7 and later models (400 at non-default values).

API version 2026-10-21 removes temperature, top_p and top_k: requests that send them return a 400 error on any model. Earlier API versions reject them only at non-default values on Claude 4.7 and later and Claude Mythos Preview.
